name: Trossen ViperX 300 S (with its gripper)
price_basis: assumed low-cost equivalent of the listed part: 5 x sqrt(list price), to the nearest $5 (see catalog/README.md, Prices)
src: Trossen figures from memory (750 g, 750 mm); price assumed

confidence.tool_frame: measured from the model's finger meshes

notes: Geometry, joint limits and mass: the MuJoCo Menagerie model (meshes derived from vendor CAD). reach_m and payload_kg are the rated figures; the composer measures the real envelope from the composed model. tool_frame is the tool point in the named body's frame; its z axis is the approach direction. finger_joints are left out of the arm's joints.
